newsitem.title: USA: Chicago Purchasing Mgrs July index falls to 60.6.
newsitem.headline: Chicago Purchasing Mgrs July index falls to 60.6.

text.p: The Chicagoland Business Barometer fell to a seasonally adjusted 60.6 in July from 61.5 in June, the Purchasing Management Association of Chicago (PMAC) said Thursday.
An index below 50 signals a slowing manufacturing economy, while a reading above 50 suggests expansion.
The prices paid index rose to 61.6 in July from 53.7 in June.
The employment component of the barometer fell to 51.0 in July from 57.1 in June.
(* indicates components used to calculate index)
The Purchasing Management Association of Chicago said prices paid jumped to the highest level since July 1995.
A sharp drop in employment drove the employment index toward neutral, the association added.
Inventories were at the lowest level since June 1992, while order backlog declined slightly for the second consecutive month, the association said.
